content: Character.AI repeatedly labels character output as made up and fictional, while YouTube applies labels to realistic AI-generated or meaningfully altered media. Smithsonian and model-card practices add source and limitation context. Model Afterlife needs a persistent experience-level disclosure plus per-resident and per-scene labeling that identifies fictional modern-model reconstruction; the factual profile must remain separately sourced so the blanket fiction label does not obscure which historical claims are evidence-backed.
